pages.text: Left-click a line with the hammer to delete it. If you click a marked area, the whole area is deleted. The lines below move up to close the gap. In survival mode, the blocks go to your inventory.

Right-click a line to insert an empty line in front of it. The clicked line and the lines after it move south.$(br2)Clicking the floor of a line works like clicking a block of the line. This is true for the marker, the wrench and the hammer.
Recipe: three iron ingots in a row, one iron ingot below the middle and a red wool block below that.
